name: Cervejaria Ramiro
description: A Lisbon beer hall famous for garlic prawns, clams and its prego, as seen in Anthony Bourdain's No Reservations (2012).
review_body: A beer hall famous for garlic prawns, clams and its prego (steak sandwich) for dessert, as seen in the Lisbon episode of Anthony Bourdain's No Reservations (2012).
